BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning officially naming a recreational trail.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to officially naming a recreational trail; and creating a new section.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature hereby renames the portion of the Milwaukee road corridor in the city of Spokane Valley known as the Appleway trail the "Senator Bob McCaslin trail."

BillSection.P: The state shall provide and install a proper marker in a suitable location in at least one main activity area of the trail identifying the name of the trail.
The legislature finds that it is appropriate to so honor Senator Bob McCaslin for his thirty years of dedicated service to the people of this state.
